title: The Rowboat at Low Tide
skyStory: Forty-three percent and waning, the moon is still in Aquarius, rowing a small boat through the clouds with a lantern on the bow. Aquarius is a visionary, but tonight it is in a gentle mood. It is just rowing, looking at the stars, wondering about the far shore. Saturn holds the other oar. Mars is asleep in the stern.

reading: Some days the Tiger hunts. Today, the Tiger helps someone else row. Look around: who in your life is in the middle of a crossing, a change, a long project, a hard week?

Offer to take the oar for a while. Not a huge favour, just a small one: run an errand, send a cheerful message, listen to them vent for ten minutes. The [[Six of Swords]] is Nancy's card, but today it is yours too, because you are the one in the boat with the extra oar. Around 8 pm, switch your onyx to your right wrist for an hour and send that steady strength to her, too.
joel.mission: Do one small, unasked favour for someone who is in the middle of something hard.
joel.omen: A rowboat, canoe or kayak pulled up on a shore. It means someone needs your help to cross.

reading: Low tide at the shore today, and the rocks are showing. The water is calm. The boat you have been rowing since January feels lighter now. You may not see the far shore yet, but you can smell the pine trees on it.

Today, let Joel take an oar. He will offer help in some form before evening: a message, a joke, a suggestion. Say yes. You do not always have to row alone, Mountain. Around 8 pm, look at your ruby and feel a little warmth from it. That is him, switching wrists. The crossing is nearly done.
nancy.mission: Accept the first offer of help you receive today, no matter how small, and say thank you.
nancy.omen: Calm water at low tide, showing rocks. It means the crossing is easier now, and the end is near.

together.text: At 8 pm, Joel switches the onyx to his right wrist, and Nancy holds the ruby up to the light. One hour, one message each: a single word describing how the crossing feels right now. The Aquarius moon rows quietly between you.

game.intro: Low tide, rowboat stuck. Paddle out with the most wrong answer you can row.
game.question: How many oars does a rowboat usually have?
